mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, pda_version, remark, force, url
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pv.id AS id, '0' AS releaseType, 'PDA升级通知' AS releaseTypeName, pv.type AS type, '' AS noticeTitle, pv.pda_version AS pdaVersion, pv.force AS force, pv.url AS url, pv.remark AS dataJson, pv.create_user_name AS createUserId, pv.create_user_name AS createUserName, pv.create_time AS createTime, pv.update_user_id AS updateUserId, pv.update_user_name AS updateUserName, pv.update_time AS updateTime, pv.upgrade_time AS upgradeTime FROM pda_version pv WHERE pv.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pv.remark ILIKE concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
UNION ALL
SELECT m.id AS id, '1' AS releaseType, '系统通知' AS releaseTypeName, m.application AS type, m.notice_title AS noticeTitle, m.upgrade_version AS pdaVersion, false AS force, '' AS url, m.data_json AS remark, m.create_user_id AS createUserId, m.create_user_name AS createUserName, m.create_time AS createTime, -- 统一列别名 m.update_user_id AS updateUserId, m.update_user_name AS updateUserName, m.update_time AS updateTime, m.notice_time AS upgradeTime FROM message m WHERE m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.type = 'sys'
AND m.data_json ILIKE concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%')
) AS combined_data ORDER BY combined_data.createTime DESC

SELECT id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, pda_version, remark, force, url, type, upgrade_time FROM pda_version pv WHERE pv.is_deleted = FALSE AND now() >= pv.upgrade_time AND pv.upgrade_time IN (SELECT MAX(upgrade_time) FROM pda_version WHERE release_type = 0) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT pusv.id FROM pda_user_skip_version pusv WHERE pv.id = pusv.version_id AND pusv.is_deleted = FALSE AND pusv.user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY pv.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
